Push the first mass, and it squeezes its spring, which pushes the next mass, and so on down the line.
text: Why does the medium matter? Think of it as a line of masses joined by springs. Push the first mass, and it squeezes its spring, which pushes the next mass, and so on down the line. The springs supply elasticity. The masses supply inertia.
